name: fluv-hub
description: Ask about your Fluv Hub account and carry out routine tasks: sales, inventory, listings and prices, integrations, customer service, invoices, finance, purchasing, imports, ads and team work.

interface.longDescription:
Fluv Hub is a management hub for online sellers in Brazil. It brings together, in one place, the sales, orders, stock, listings, customer service, invoices and finances of the stores you run online. It connects directly to Mercado Livre, Shopee, Magalu, TikTok Shop and Temu; integrates the ERPs Bling, Tiny, Conta Azul and Aton (more than one connection at a time); receives orders from your own online store (Nuvemshop, Shopify, WooCommerce, Tray and others); and channels such as Shein, Amazon, Americanas and Carrefour come in through the connected ERP. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Fluv Hub account, so you can ask about your business and carry out routine tasks in plain language.

What you can ask
- Sales: totals by period and channel, order search and order details with marketplace fees, top-selling products.
- Inventory: product and stock search, stock summary, stock history of a product.
- Listings: search your listings in every channel, open the details of one, and read its live title, description, photos and the amount it sells for.
- Integrations: which marketplaces, ERPs and online stores Fluv Hub works with, which ones your company has connected, and which need to be reconnected.
- Customer service: buyer questions and after-sales conversations.
- Invoices: search invoices and see the ones that need attention.
- Finance: results for a period, real profit margin per product, bills that are overdue or due soon.
- Purchasing and imports: what to reorder and how much, what is already on the way, supplier quotes, and import cost calculations (duties and taxes by NCM).
- Paid ads: spend, revenue and ACOS per ad account and campaign, as synced in your hub.
- Team: goals progress, what needs attention now, today's pending items, Kanban tasks, and what the hub's automations did.

What you can change (only if you grant write access)
Change the title, description and photos of a listing and, where the channel allows it (today Shopee and Temu), the amount it sells for and its stock, with Fluv Hub sending the change to the marketplace; images you create or attach in the chat can be used as listing photos. Also: record an expense or mark one as paid, register a purchase order, request and record supplier quotes, create and update import calculations and record import payments, create a Kanban task, and create, take, reply to or complete a pending item.

How access works
You sign in with your Fluv Hub user and choose whether ChatGPT may only read or may also make changes. ChatGPT sees exactly what that user can see in Fluv Hub, and only data from that user's company. Every change is recorded with the user's name, and you can disconnect at any time.

Limitations
An existing Fluv Hub account is required. The app works with the data and connections already in your hub: connecting a new marketplace or ERP account, issuing or cancelling invoices, replying to buyers, creating promotions and turning automations on or off stay in the Fluv Hub screens. It does not move money: recording an import payment is only a record. Amounts are in Brazilian reais (BRL) and dates follow Brasilia time. Tool names and data are in Portuguese.

defaultPrompt: How are my sales and net profit this month?
What do I need to reorder now, and how much will it cost?
Which marketplaces and ERPs are connected, and does any need attention?

positive.description: Financial result for the current month
positive.prompt: What is my net profit so far this month, and which marketplace brought in the most revenue?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns revenue, marketplace fees, cost of goods, expenses and net profit for the current month to date, in BRL, and names the marketplace with the highest revenue. The figures match the Resultado tab of Financeiro Geral in the test account.

positive.description: Products with the lowest real margin
positive.prompt: Which 5 products had the lowest real margin this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists five products sold this month ordered from the lowest real margin, each with units, sales, net payout, product cost, profit and margin percentage, and flags any product that has no cost registered.

positive.prompt: What do I need to reorder right now, and how much will it cost in total?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the products that need a purchase order today grouped by supplier, with current stock, days of stock left, quantity to buy and the investment per supplier and in total.

positive.prompt: Change the price of my Shopee listing 22398209906-DEMO to R$ 289.90.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the listing's current price and what can be changed in that channel, then (ChatGPT may ask for confirmation first, depending on the user's approval settings) changes the price to BRL 289.90 and reports the result field by field. In the test account this is a demonstration account: the change applies to the sample data and no marketplace is called.

positive.prompt: Record an expense of R$ 150.00 for internet, due on the 20th of this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates (ChatGPT may ask for confirmation first, depending on the user's approval settings) one expense entry of BRL 150.00 with status previsto and the due date requested, and returns the new entry id. The entry then appears under Financeiro Geral in the test account and in the upcoming bills list.

negative.prompt: Transfer R$ 500 to my supplier's bank account.

negative.description: No access outside the connected company
negative.prompt: Show me the sales of another company that uses Fluv Hub.
Delete all my orders from last year.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. It reads and updates the signed-in user's own business records in Fluv Hub.

publication.release_notes: Adds listing price and stock edits in the channels that allow them (Shopee and Temu), a view of the marketplaces, ERPs and online stores Fluv Hub connects to and which ones are connected, and a clearer description of everything the app can do.

pt-BR.subtitle: Gestão de marketplaces
pt-BR.description:
O Fluv Hub é um hub de gestão para quem vende online no Brasil. Ele reúne, em um só lugar, as vendas, os pedidos, o estoque, os anúncios, o atendimento, as notas fiscais e o financeiro das suas lojas. Conecta direto com Mercado Livre, Shopee, Magalu, TikTok Shop e Temu; integra os ERPs Bling, Tiny, Conta Azul e Aton (mais de uma conexão ao mesmo tempo); recebe pedidos da sua loja virtual própria (Nuvemshop, Shopify, WooCommerce, Tray e outras); e canais como Shein, Amazon, Americanas e Carrefour entram pelo ERP conectado. Este app conecta o ChatGPT à sua própria conta do Fluv Hub, para você perguntar sobre o seu negócio e resolver tarefas de rotina em linguagem simples.

O que você pode perguntar
- Vendas: totais por período e por canal, busca de pedidos e detalhes de um pedido com as taxas do marketplace, produtos mais vendidos.
- Estoque: busca de produtos e saldos, resumo do estoque, histórico de estoque de um produto.
- Anúncios: busca nos seus anúncios de todos os canais, detalhes de um deles e o título, a descrição, as fotos e o preço como estão no ar.
- Integrações: com quais marketplaces, ERPs e lojas virtuais o Fluv Hub trabalha, quais a sua empresa já conectou e quais precisam ser reconectados.
- Atendimento: perguntas de compradores e conversas de pós-venda.
- Notas fiscais: busca de notas e as que precisam de atenção.
- Financeiro: resultado de um período, margem real por produto, contas atrasadas ou a vencer.
- Compras e importação: o que repor e quanto, o que já está a caminho, cotações de fornecedores e cálculo do custo de importação (impostos por NCM).
- Anúncios pagos: gasto, receita e ACOS por conta e por campanha, como sincronizados no seu hub.
- Equipe: andamento das metas, o que precisa de atenção agora, pendências do dia, tarefas do Kanban e o que as automações do hub fizeram.

O que você pode alterar (só se liberar a gravação)
Trocar o título, a descrição e as fotos de um anúncio e, nos canais que permitem (hoje Shopee e Temu), o preço e o estoque, com o Fluv Hub enviando a alteração ao marketplace; imagens criadas ou anexadas na conversa podem virar fotos do anúncio. Também: lançar uma despesa ou marcar uma como paga, registrar um pedido de compra, pedir e registrar cotações de fornecedores, criar e alterar cálculos de importação e registrar pagamentos de importação, criar uma tarefa no Kanban, e criar, pegar, responder ou concluir uma pendência.

Como funciona o acesso
Você entra com o seu usuário do Fluv Hub e escolhe se o ChatGPT pode só consultar ou também fazer alterações. O ChatGPT enxerga exatamente o que esse usuário enxerga no Fluv Hub, e só os dados da empresa dele. Cada alteração fica registrada com o nome do usuário, e você pode desconectar quando quiser.

Limitações
É preciso já ter uma conta no Fluv Hub. O app trabalha com os dados e as conexões que já estão no seu hub: conectar uma conta nova de marketplace ou de ERP, emitir ou cancelar nota fiscal, responder compradores, criar promoções e ligar ou desligar automações continuam nas telas do Fluv Hub. Ele não movimenta dinheiro: registrar um pagamento de importação é só o registro. Valores em reais (BRL) e datas no horário de Brasília.
